speaker: Doctor

DIAGNOSIS READY: Inflammatory Bowel Disease (Ulcerative Colitis)

Given the classic presentation of chronic diarrhea, mucus, urgency, relief with defecation, and the inflammatory markers requested earlier, the clinical picture strongly points to Ulcerative Colitis rather than infectious colitis.
